Who We Are

A Reliable Partner for Industrial Pipeline Needs

Established in Kamathipura, Mumbai, Sujal Enterprise is a trusted supplier of heavy-duty industrial pipe fittings, flanges, and piping raw materials.

We deliver to sectors like oil & gas, chemicals, power plants, and civil infrastructure, ensuring all supplied materials align with ASME, ASTM, and DIN standards. We support Third Party Inspections (SGS, TUV, Lloyds) to assure absolute material integrity.
